# `/my-violations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /my-violations/v1

`listMyViolationsV1` — List My Policy Violations

Returns a paged list of policy violations where the current user is the owner (directly assigned or via a governance group they belong to). No permission scope is required; caller identity is required. Supports the same collection parameters as GET /violations (limit, offset, count, filters, sorters), including the same filter field whitelist and processing (normalization, pruning of not-yet-persisted name predicates). The owner filter is implicit (current user); **do not** use `ownerId` in…

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:read
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: status: eq, in; policyId: eq; level: eq, in; policyName: eq, in, sw, co; ownerName: eq, in, sw, co; targetName: eq, in, sw, co; targetId: eq, in — e.g. `status in ("Open","Mitigated") and level eq "High"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: level Prefix a field with - for descending order, for example -level. If omitted, default ordering matches GET /violations (created descending, then id descending). — e.g. `-level`
- Returns 200: array of policyviolationresponse
